description: This file contains TensorFlow DTensor helper functions for random number generation and dropout operations, specifically for stateless RNGs with layout support, as well as auxiliary utilities.

methods.name: _old_tf_random_stateless_normal( shape, seed, mean=0.0, stddev=1.0, dtype=dtypes.float32, name=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Implementation of DTensor stateless normal distribution with layout support.

methods.name: _old_tf_random_stateless_uniform( shape, seed, minval=0, maxval=None, dtype=dtypes.float32, name=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Implementation of DTensor stateless uniform distribution with layout support.

methods.name: _old_tf_stateless_truncated_normal( shape, seed, mean=0.0, stddev=1.0, dtype=dtypes.float32, name=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Implementation of DTensor stateless truncated normal distribution with layout support.

methods.name: stateless_random_normal( shape, seed, mean=0.0, stddev=1.0, dtype=dtypes.float32, name=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Public API to generate DTensor stateless normal random tensor, calls internal implementation.

methods.name: stateless_random_uniform( shape, seed, minval=0, maxval=None, dtype=dtypes.float32, name=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Public API to generate DTensor stateless uniform random tensor, calls internal implementation.

methods.name: stateless_truncated_normal( shape, seed, mean=0.0, stddev=1.0, dtype=dtypes.float32, name=None, layout=None, )
methods.description: Public API for DTensor stateless truncated normal distribution, calls internal implementation.

methods.name: stateless_split(seed, num=2, mesh=None)
methods.description: Splits a seed into multiple seeds and generates multiple uniform random tensors with layout support.

methods.name: _get_noise_shape(x, noise_shape)
methods.description: Utility to compute noise shape for dropout, copied from TF.

methods.name: dropout(x, rate, noise_shape=None, seed=None, name=None)
methods.description: DTensor-based dropout implementation with stateless random uniform sampling and optional layout propagation.
